actions: Keep SLO claims out of release approval unless the full window exists.
Report only observed metrics and their timestamps.
analysis: A short drill window cannot prove a 7-day SLO or a percentage improvement; reports must state the evidence boundary.
excerpt: 告警只验证本地 webhook 通知链路。Prometheus 7 天 SLO 目标为 99.9%，本次未积累完整 7 天窗口，不宣称 SLO 已达标，也不编造恢复效率提升百分比。
rollback: Collect a complete window before making an SLO claim.
title: SLO 声明边界
